text:
support_jamie: customer reporting sudden 503s across multiple endpoints since ~08:20 UTC. They say requests hit a specific model variant and auth flows sometimes time out. Raising now and attaching initial logs. @oncall_maya can you pick up? :alarm_clock:

oncall_maya: taking. any 5xx codes in gateway logs or pure upstream 503s?

support_jamie: looks like upstream inference workers returning 500/503. Gateway shows upstream_healthcheck OK but request proxy returns 502/503 intermittently. Customer says it started after a heavy authenticated toolcall burst (many concurrent streaming sessions).

eng-ryan: I see worker restarts in runner logs around same time. Short snippet from node journal: ```
Mar 18 08:19:44 runner-17 systemd[1]: Starting infer-runner...
Mar 18 08:19:44 infer-runner[12345]: runtime: segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f1a2c3e exp+0x1b0
Mar 18 08:19:44 infer-runner[12345]: signal 11 (SIGSEGV), code 1 (SEGV_MAPERR)
Mar 18 08:19:44 infer-runner[12345]: killer: cgroup oom_reaper triggered?
```

eng-ml-kiwi: also seeing NVML OOM events on the same host: ```
[GPU0] Out of memory trying to allocate 3.2GiB (requested by model kv-cache prefetch)
[GPU0] cudaErrorMemoryAllocation
```

support_jamie: customer provided sample request id xreq_9abc that produced 503. Attached stacktrace and request headers, includes Authorization: Bearer <token-redacted>.

customer_ops: customer is escalating because their webhooks are failing and retrying. They want a short-term mitigation to stop retries causing more restarts.

oncall_maya: mitigation steps: 1) throttle incoming auth-heavy routes at gateway for this customer 2) route to fallback smaller model variant (cpu or lower-VRAM quantized) 3) disable aggressive kv-prefetch for that pool. Can we apply quick routing rule? @eng-ryan?

eng-ryan: I can push a temporary route to send traffic from that customer ID to model:curie-quantized-v2 and set max_concurrency=8 for their token. Will also flip kv_prefetch=false on the pool. Doing now. Also pulling core dumps from /var/crash/runner-17/core.* and uploading to /mnt/incidents/1719991001-core.tgz for deeper debug.

runtime-bot: deploy triggered: route-rule-upsert by eng-ryan at 08:27 UTC. Change-id: rr-20260318-1719991001. Autoscale unchanged.

eng-ml-kiwi: temporary changes live. initial telemetry: error rate for that customer dropped from 18% -> 3% after routing to quantized model and throttling. GPU OOMs stopped on runner-17 but there are related segfault stackframes suggesting a possible kernel-level race in kv-cache prefetch on large concurrent streams.

support_jamie: shared mitigations and ETA with customer: throttles, fallback routing, and we collected logs for postmortem. Customer happy for now but wants RCA and timeline.

eng-ryan: next steps for eng-runtime: 1) reproduce locally with stress harness reproducing auth+broadcast toolcall workload (we have their anonymized prompt set) 2) run with ASAN build and nvprof to capture prefetch allocation patterns 3) check for recent kernel/driver updates on runner-17 (driver version: 535.54, CUDA 12.2) 4) audit kv-cache prefetch code for absent null checks causing segfault when allocation fails.

eng-ml-kiwi: adding a regression test to CI that simulates concurrent streaming + kv_prefetch on quantized runtime. If we can repro with smaller VMs we can iterate faster.

oncall_maya: leaving follow-up with eng postmortem. tagging incident severity P2 given customer impact but mitigated. @support_jamie please keep customer notified and ask for any sample payloads they can share that hit the failure quickly.

support_jamie: will do. attaching the sample request and linking the heap/profile: https://s3.redwood-infra/internal/1719991001/customer-sample.tgz

eng-ryan: for now, recommend we add a fail-safe in runtime: if NVML reports OOM during kv_prefetch, gracefully fallback to on-demand fetch (no prefetch) instead of crash. I'll open a PR and target a canary deploy later today.

customer_ops: customer acknowledged and paused aggressive retries. They want a follow-up call tomorrow.

noncall_maya: closing immediate paging loop. document incident and include timeline. :white_check_mark:
